symbols.name: address set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of addresses at which every array on the network's wires is indexed.
symbols.quote: The values on a wire form an array indexed by a finite address set $\Omega$, the set of addresses at which the network stores values.

symbols.name: input role
symbols.meaning: An input role, the fixed place where the network takes in one of its values.
symbols.quote: An input role is written $w$, and the network carries it to an output role $\rho(w)$.

symbols.name: output role map
symbols.meaning: The map sending each input role $w$ to the output role $\rho(w)$ that carries it.
symbols.quote: An input role is written $w$, and the network carries it to an output role $\rho(w)$.

symbols.name: prescribed sign
symbols.meaning: The fixed sign, plus or minus one, that the route from input role $w$ applies.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible linear operator on arrays indexed by $\Omega$ attached to the vertex $v$.
symbols.quote: Each source, gate and sink $v$ carries an invertible linear operator $D_v$ on arrays indexed by $\Omega$, its *frame*.

symbols.name: tail vertex
symbols.meaning: A vertex of the network, the vertex where an edge starts.
symbols.quote: For vertices $\alpha$ and $\beta$, an edge from $\alpha$ to $\beta$ changes the stored array by $D_\beta D_\alpha^{-1}$ and leaves the logical array fixed.

symbols.name: head vertex
symbols.meaning: A vertex of the network, the vertex where an edge from $\alpha$ ends.
symbols.quote: For vertices $\alpha$ and $\beta$, an edge from $\alpha$ to $\beta$ changes the stored array by $D_\beta D_\alpha^{-1}$ and leaves the logical array fixed.

symbols.name: source vertex
symbols.meaning: The source vertex where the input role $w$ enters the network.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathrm{source}(w)$ is the source vertex where role $w$ enters, and $\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))$ is the sink vertex where output role $\rho(w)$ leaves; the wiring fixes both.

symbols.name: sink vertex
symbols.meaning: The sink vertex where the output role $\rho(w)$ leaves the network.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathrm{source}(w)$ is the source vertex where role $w$ enters, and $\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))$ is the sink vertex where output role $\rho(w)$ leaves; the wiring fixes both.

symbols.name: example address
symbols.meaning: One address in $\Omega$ at which the worked example is evaluated.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi$ be one address, and let the two wires carry the values $\lambda$ and $\mu$ at $\xi$.

symbols.name: first example value
symbols.meaning: The value on the first wire at the address $\xi$ in the example.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi$ be one address, and let the two wires carry the values $\lambda$ and $\mu$ at $\xi$.

symbols.name: second example value
symbols.meaning: The value on the second wire at the address $\xi$ in the example.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi$ be one address, and let the two wires carry the values $\lambda$ and $\mu$ at $\xi$.

relations.quote: Each frame $D_v$ is invertible, so the network has frames of full [matrix rank](matrix-rank.md) on $\Omega$.
